jobs.description:
**WILD AUF WIRKSAMKEIT?**
-------------------------


Dann lass uns reden.


Du willst exzellente Software entwickeln und betreuen?


Du liebst es, Kundenprobleme zu lösen?


Du willst dabei gesellschaftlich relevante Beiträge leisten?


Du willst kollegial und professionell arbeiten?


Du willst in neue Themen, Technologien und Märkte wachsen?


Du bringst zu Ende, was Du angefangen hast?


Dir ist Gestaltungskraft wichtiger als Führungskräfte?

### **Dann sind wir vermutlich ein Match.**

#### **Wer wir sind.**


Wir bei Pradtke sind **Marktführer für Personaleinsatzsoftware** in Krankenhäusern, Feuerwehren und anderen Einrichtungen der Daseinsfürsorge. In der Software\-Branche besonders ist, dass wir diese Position als **selbstbestimmtes Familienunternehmen** innehaben.


Wir sind **kerngesund** und **wachsen** stetig weiter – in Köpfen und Könnerschaften, im Kaufmännischen, in Feature\-Kategorien, Kunden und in Kerntechnologien.

#### **Was wir machen.**


Unsere App »TIMEOFFICE« sorgt mit kollaborativer Einsatzplanung, digitaler Zeiterfassung, umfassenden Compliance\-Checks, raschem Engpass\-Management, präziser Lohnabrechnung und guten Controlling\-Tools dafür, dass unsere Kunden optimal arbeiten und Bestmögliches für uns alle leisten können. Technologisch ist TIMEOFFICE eine **moderne Web\-App**, die wir künftig auch aus der eigenen Cloud als **Software as a Service** anbieten werden.


TIMEOFFICE wird in etwa 400 Krankenhäusern in Deutschland eingesetzt, zusätzlich bei etwa 70 Feuerwehren. Pradtke ist in diesen Schwerpunktmärkten **mit rund 25% Marktanteil jeweils führend**. Wir sind aber auch in anderen Bereichen der Daseinsfürsorge wie bspw. Rettungsdiensten, Jugendhilfe oder Altenpflege präsent und haben vor, demnächst weitere Branchen zu bedienen.

#### **Wie wir arbeiten.**


Aktuell sind wir bei Pradtke rund 60 Menschen. Seit 2024 arbeiten wir nicht mehr in abgeschlossenen Abteilungen wie bspw. Entwicklung, Beratung oder Vertrieb, sondern in **dezentralen und selbstorganisierten Teams**, die wir Zellen nennen. Sie betreuen autonom und führungskräftefrei ihre eigenen Kunden und bringen alle Könnerschaften mit, die es dafür braucht. Jeder in unseren Teams hat mehrere Rollen und nimmt sich mit der Zeit weitere. Das nennen wir **Multi\-Spezialisierung**. Viele dieser Rollen haben mit unmittelbarer Arbeit für unsere Kunden zu tun.

**Kollegialität und Arbeiten auf Zuruf** sind uns wichtig. Daher sind wir üblicherweise an mindestens drei Tagen die Wochein Bochum vor Ort im Office.


Wir sind nicht nur in unseren Zellen zuhause, sondern übernehmen als Mitunternehmer auch Verantwortung für Pradtke als Ganzes und sind – zusätzlich zum normalen Gehalt – **am Unternehmenserfolg beteiligt**.

### **WAS DEINE AUFGABEN SIND**

  

Als Senior\-Entwickler:in gestaltest Du bei uns Produkt und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mit und bist in Trägerschaft für wichtige Prozesse wie Projekte. Konkret heißt das:

* Du entwickelst Frontend\- und Backend\-Komponenten von TIMEOFFICE weiter und übernimmst Verantwortung über den eigenen Code hinaus.
* Du entwirfst Architekturen, Schnittstellen und technische Konzepte und setzt sie auch um.
* Du stellst Code\-Qualität, Wartbarkeit und Testabdeckung über den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess hinweg sicher.
* Du gestaltest unsere technologische Ausrichtung, Toolchains und Entwicklungsprozesse aktiv mit.
* Du arbeitest eng und kollegial mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Disziplinen zusammen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen.
* Du befähigst Kolleg:innen durch Deine Expertise, teilst Dein Wissen und unterstützt andere in ihrer professionellen Entwicklung.

**Unser gemeinsames Ziel:** Wirksamkeit und Arbeitsfreude in Kliniken, Feuerwehren und anderen Kundenorganisationen stärken – und dabei selbst mit viel Freude und hohem Eigenanspruch arbeiten.

### **WAS WIR UNS VON DIR WÜNSCHEN…**

 **Du bist erfahrene:r Full\-Stack\-Entwickler:in mit ausgeprägtem Allrounder\-Profil. Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstorganisiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch – und weißt zugleich, wie man pragmatisch Strecke macht.**

  

* Im Frontend setzen wir Vue/Vuetify und TypeScript ein. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit modernen SPA\-Frameworks mit – vergleichbare Praxis mit React oder Angular ist ebenso relevant.
* Im Backend verfügst Du über tiefe Praxis mit ASP.NET Core Web APIs und Microsoft SQL Server oder PostgreSQL mit Entity Framework. REST\-basierte Architekturen, saubere API\-Schnitte sowie ein solides Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Performance sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
* Unsere Services betreiben wir cloud\-native bei Stackit mit Kubernetes und Terraform.Du hast idealerweise produktive Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und verstehst Cloud\-Infrastruktur im Allgemeinen. Nicht nur als Deployment\-Ziel, sondern, im Sinne von DevOps, als Teil der Architektur, die Du mit gestaltest und betreibst.
* Qualitätssicherung ist fester Bestandteil Deiner Arbeit: testgetriebene Entwicklung, Komponenten\-, Integrations\- und End\-to\-End\-Tests sind für Dich gute und geübte Praxis.
* Boilerplate\-Code lässt Du gerne von AI erledigen, z.B. von GitHub Copilot oder Claude Code – mit klarem Blick auf Codequalität, Wartbarkeit und Verantwortung.
* Du kommunizierst offen und zugewandt, gibst konstruktiven Rat und forderst aktiv Hilfe ein, wenn es mal schwierig wird.
* Stillstand ist nichts für Dich. Du hast Lust auf Neues – in Technologien, fachlichen Domänen und Denkweisen.
* Dein Hochschulstudium hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen
* Mind. 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung als EntwicklerIn
* Deutsch und Englisch kommunizierst Du fliessend in Wort und Schrift
* Du lebst in räumlicher Nähe zu Bochum und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg:innen im Büro produktiv zu sein
* Bereitschaft und Freude an der Arbeit im direkten Kundenkontakt

### **WAS WIR DIR BIETEN...**

* **Einarbeitung on the** Job : Kein Beamer, keine langweiligen PowerPoints. Stattdessen: Gemeinsam machen! Miteinander\-füreinander.
* **Sinnstiftende Arbeit:** Unsere Lösungen beeinflussen den Arbeitsalltag von über 300\.000 Menschen der Daseinsfürsorge.
* **Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe:** Wir setzen auf Eigenverantwortung, Dezentralität und Teamautonomie.
* **Sicherheit:** Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag von Anfang an.
* **Attraktive Benefits:** Betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Altersvorsorge, Dienstfahrradprogramm.


Aber das Beste an Pradtke? **Das erlebst du erst, wenn du uns kennenlernst.**

**WAT NU?**
-----------


Du bist neugierig geworden? Bewirb dich! Selbst wenn du dir nicht sicher bist, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst – überzeug uns einfach davon, dass **genau du** uns fehlst.


Im Bewerbungsprozess setzen wir auf Peer Recruiting. Wenn wir Dich einladen, bedeutet das, dass Du mindestens fünf zukünftige Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Rahmen von Gesprächen kennenlernen wirst – und sie wiederum Dich.


Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.description:
**About The Company**



GROPYUS is a technology\-based construction company focused on building multi\-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

**About the Role**



You will be part of a highly collaborative product team working at the core of our manufacturing facility, transforming digital models into physical elements at scale.



Product Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including underlying infrastructure, build pipelines, automated testing, release and rollout management, monitoring, and support. You will bring your experience in working with PLCs and/or other OT systems like e.g. robots, into the team.



As a Software Engineer (PLC / OT), you will work with your team on evolving the rather traditional architecture of MES like systems integrating via OPC\-UA with PLCs into a future\-proof architecture built with **Software Defined Manufacturing** in mind. You should be looking forward to developing less PLC / OT code over time and building a solution that allows for full **simulation** of upcoming manufacturing orders.



Furthermore, our teams are also responsible for operating and troubleshooting the software they have developed during working hours of the factory.


**What you'll be doing**



As a Software Engineer (f/m/d) on the Product Delivery team, you will be responsible for:


* **Understanding and explaining** the existing PLC / OT code base from our vendor to the rest of your team.
* Working together with your team and other teams in Product Delivery to **evolve** the current architecture into a truly **Software Defined Manufacturing** setup.
* Bringing an o**perational mindset** to monitor, maintain, and improve software uptime including reliable updates, latency, and efficiency
* Acting as a bridge between digital product delivery \& physical logistics and manufacturing systems, ensuring both are aligned and integrated
* Helping define, monitor and evolve **SLAs/SLOs** as well as other important KPIs like e.g. OEE for critical systems


**What you bring**


* You are an experienced software / automation engineer with experience in **PLC** or other **OT** technologies
* You are willing and excited to adopt modern software engineering approaches like code reviews, testing, CI/CD, etc.
* You have operated and supported large\-scale software / OT systems
* You have worked in companies with **strong operational cultures**, ideally in logistics or manufacturing – understanding the commercial impact of system downtime
* You are proficient with most of the following technologies:
* + PLC programming (TIA19 is a plus)
	+ Robot programming (KRL is a plus)
	+ OPC\-UA
	+ MQTT is a plus
	+ Python / C\+\+ / C\# is a plus
* You are familiar with monitoring and alerting practices for production systems
* You have experience defining and working with SLAs/SLOs
* You are willing to travel to our manufacturing site in Richen whenever needed and within Germany and Austria for in\-person team events

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* An **unlimited** contract with 30 vacation days.
* **Flexible, hybrid work:** You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day.
* **Attractive perks and benefits**: We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions.
* **Virtual Shares Program**: Participate in the success of GROPYUS through our Virtual Share Program.
* **Ownership**: You can truly make your mark with your work and contributions – on all our organizational levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them.
* **The chance to be part of something big**: Our mission is to rethink an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and fostering sustainable, affordable living.
* **A diverse and enriching work environment**: Become a valued member of a wonderfully diverse team of individuals from over 50 countries. At GROPYUS we value inclusion above all, ensuring that everyone feels they belong – no matter their background. In this way, our differences become strengths that help us grow as a team.

#### **Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.**

**We can't wait to get to know you.**
**For more information, visit our** **website****.**

 **Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds**


With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world\-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works.



The digital transformation of buildings is a fast\-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology \- it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first.



Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure.



Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go?


As a student trainee, intern or trainee, you are an important part of \#TeamSiemens. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of **Working Student** **Software Development** **40\-60%** – your team is looking forward to meeting you!

  

**About the team**


Tools, Services and Infrastructure (TSI) develops and supports the tools, applications and infrastructure for the global SI B PRO R\&D organization, owning the full lifecycle of the PLM/ALM toolchain used by 5,000\+ end users, with 3,000\+ tickets resolved per year and 100\+ tools managed. Within TSI, Applications \& Data Insights develops applications, integrations and data products, extending the ALM ecosystem with automation and AI. Our landscape includes:


* IBM Jazz ALM for agile project management, requirements, test and system design — plus Report Builder and a large in\-house extension portfolio (50\+ Jazz plugins and custom tools)
* Source code, build and quality tooling: Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, UrbanCode Deploy, build and test environments
* R\&D financial and business processes (Jedox\-based budgeting and cost tracking)
* Reporting and analytics: IBM Report Builder today, moving progressively to Power BI and Snowflake for Management Events , alongside KPI dashboards and data products


We use SAFe agile approach with local developers, remote team members and external suppliers in close cooperation. Beyond support, maintenance and continuous delivery, we train our users and maintain the documentation and knowledge base that keeps our services self\-serviceable.

  

**Your role**


You will join our development team to further develop the tools above into user\-centric, future\-proof solutions, and you will contribute directly to extend and create plugins and tools, and infusing AI capabilities into the tool landscape (Jazz / WISPR / MCP integrations, Jazz Copilot).

  

  

**Your new responsibilities**

* You support the development of new features across the TI tool landscape, collaborating closely with experienced software engineers and participating in projects, change management and training for new technology implementations
* Building on this, you contribute to the entire engineering cycle by assisting in requirements analysis, architecture and design, coding, deployment and ongoing support
* In this context, you produce clean, efficient code to specification, integrate software components and REST\-based interfaces, and help verify and deploy programs and systems
* Additionally, you maintain and upgrade existing software, troubleshoot coding issues efficiently, and help fix defects to ensure application and plugin reliability
* Complementing these tasks, you help create technical documentation for various audiences and contribute to the team wiki and knowledge base
 **Your talents and experience**

* You are currently enrolled in a Swiss university degree program in computer science, software engineering or a related field and have initial practical experience in software development
* You have hands\-on experience with object\-oriented programming languages such as Java, C\# or .NET Core
* You are familiar with web technologies and frameworks, including basic frontend development with JavaScript, HTML and CSS
* You have knowledge of REST APIs and integration patterns, and are confident in using version control systems such as Git
* You demonstrate a high level of analytical ability, learn new technologies quickly and work in a structured, thorough and independent manner
* You have very good English and or German skills
 **Employee benefits**


* Mobile working from anywhere within Switzerland
* Opportunity to develop an international professional network
* Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
* Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members
 **Our corporate culture – your new working environment**



The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day\-to\-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future\-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work\-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz!

Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly.

Build the integrations that make complex access solutions work.
  
  

What happens when a customer needs SKIDATA products to work with a system they already rely on? That’s where you come in.
  
  

As a Backend Developer, you’ll design and build tailored software integrations that connect third\-party systems with SKIDATA products. You’ll solve varied technical challenges, work with integration partners and turn specific customer requirements into working solutions.
  
  

Why this role matters
  
  

Access solutions need to work seamlessly with the wider systems customers depend on. Your work will help turn specific customer requirements into reliable solutions, extending the flexibility and reach of SKIDATA products across different markets and real\-world environments.
  
  

The role
  
  

You’ll independently own integration projects, from technical design through implementation, testing and documentation, while working as part of the global GCS team. Alongside your development work, you’ll support colleagues across regions and contribute to shared coding, architecture and engineering practices.

Build custom integrations — design, develop, test and document backend solutions connecting third\-party systems with SKIDATA products.

Work with APIs and interfaces — develop and integrate solutions using technologies such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ and sockets.
  
Support integration partners — provide integration support for public interfaces and help third\-party companies connect with SKIDATA systems.

Professional backend experience — at least 3\-5 years of professional experience developing and maintaining backend applications in C\# / .NET, with the ability to work independently after onboarding.

Why SKIDATA
  
  

At SKIDATA, you’ll work on technology that connects access solutions with the wider systems customers rely on, while having the autonomy to own your work and collaborate with colleagues across borders.
  
  

Meaningful impact — Build integrations that help SKIDATA access solutions work seamlessly with the systems customers and partners depend on.
  
Innovation \& scale — Work with modern backend technologies, APIs and integration solutions as part of a global organisation.
  
Autonomy \& trust — Take ownership of your projects from design through delivery, with the freedom to shape solutions and solve problems in your own way.
  
Growth \& development — Broaden your technical experience through varied projects, different technologies and collaboration with colleagues across regions.
  
Work–life balance — Benefit from a flexible hybrid working model in Madrid that supports a sustainable way of working.
  
  

Ready to build what connects it all?

Apply today (with a CV in english) and help build the connections that make SKIDATA’s access solutions work in the real world.

StateTick is a software-defined machine control ecosystem that unifies building, testing, simulating, and running industrial machines in a single environment.
